create.name: Rabbi Daniel Raphael Silverstein
create.bio:
Rabbi Daniel Raphael Silverstein is a teacher of Jewish meditation, Kabbalah and Chasidic thought, and the founder and director of Applied Jewish Spirituality, an online school run from Tzur Hadassa near Jerusalem. His path took in Buddhist retreats and chi kung before six years of study in Orthodox yeshivot, and he was ordained a rabbi at Yeshivat Chovevei Torah in New York. He also trained as a Jewish mindfulness meditation teacher through a programme run by the Institute for Jewish Spirituality with the Awakened Heart Project, teaches at the Conservative Yeshiva, and performs as a spoken-word artist and MC.

At Applied Jewish Spirituality he and a faculty of rabbis and meditation teachers offer recorded and live courses that treat the prayer book, the weekly Torah portion and the Chasidic masters as sources of practice, not only study. His own courses include an introduction to the sefirot of the Tree of Life, a year with the Ba'al Shem Tov's teachings on the Torah cycle, the world of Rebbe Nachman, and contemplative approaches to the morning and Shabbat prayers. Members join a monthly gathering built around twelve big life questions and get access to the full library, and the school shares free guides to practices such as hitbodedut and breath meditation.

courses.title: AJS Membership
courses.description: Monthly membership of his online school, centred on The Jewish Spiritual Path, a year of monthly live gatherings on twelve big life questions. It also opens the library of more than fifty recorded courses and weekly teachings on the Torah portion.

courses.title: Intro to Kabbalah: The Sefirot of the Tree of Life
courses.description: Eight recorded classes on the ten sefirot, looking at how generations of Kabbalists understood them and how they show up in character, relationships and work.

courses.title: Living the Torah Cycle with the Ba'al Shem Tov
courses.description: Twelve recorded sessions working through the weekly Torah readings with teachings of the founder of Chasidism, combining text study, discussion and practice.

courses.title: The World of Rebbe Nachman
courses.description: Eight recorded classes on the life, sayings and stories of Rebbe Nachman of Breslov and the inner path he taught.

courses.title: Meditating Through the Morning Service
courses.description: Eighteen recorded sessions treating key prayers of the daily morning service as meditations, with traditional commentary and guided practice for each.

courses.title: Deepening Shabbat Prayer
courses.description: Eight recorded sessions on the contemplative meaning of the Sabbath prayers and ways to pray them with more presence.

free_resources.title: Rabbi Daniel Raphael Silverstein on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: His free guided Jewish meditations on the Insight Timer app.

free_resources.title: Hitbodedut: Speaking to God in Our Own Words
free_resources.description: A free guide to the Breslov practice of secluded, spontaneous personal prayer.

free_resources.title: Breathing Meditation
free_resources.description: A free introduction to a Jewish approach to meditating with the breath.

free_resources.title: Eating Meditation
free_resources.description: A free practice for bringing attention and blessing to the act of eating.
